data.description: Ôrise: Contemporary Design Meets Comfort in Dubai
data.long_description:
Ôrise is a stunning architectural masterpiece located in the thriving heart of Dubai Maritime City. It comprises two towers, 51 stories (G+4P+46) and 32 stories (G+4P+27) high, connected by a shared podium. The complex offers luxurious 1-3 bedroom apartments, 2-3 bedroom chalets, spacious signature 3-4 bedroom collections, and penthouses. Its design is both elegant and impressive. Residential units feature a 10-degree incline, providing breathtaking, unobstructed views of the vibrant cityscape and sparkling sea. Each space balances contemporary design with personal comfort.

Ôrise residents have access to a host of world-class amenities including a gym, creative hub, co-working areas, sauna and steam rooms, leisure and lap pools, Zen Garden and Vitality Centre, green oasis and olive garden, and a kids' corner.

The complex benefits from a prime and convenient location, offering easy access to major landmarks: Dubai International Airport (14 minutes), Mina Rashid (2 minutes), Downtown and Burj Khalifa (12 minutes), DIFC (9 minutes), The Gold Souk (12 minutes), and Jumeirah Beach Coast (7 minutes).

Ôrise is a symphony of architecture and comfort, where every day is filled with inspiration and opportunities, offering a life lived at its peak in every sense.
